title: Visitors confirm Kennedy-UFO connection

tellings.quote: although but definitely the Kennedy and UFOs were correct and and that was a huge part of

plain: In 1996, visitors to the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a television show about UFOs, told its makers that the show had got one thing right: President Kennedy really was connected to the UFO secret. A television writer named Bryce Zabel, who says he was there, tells Michels that the visitors, whom he names only as JC and "the captain", said that "definitely the Kennedy and UFOs were correct." If true, it would mean insiders were confirming that Kennedy had some tie to the UFO question.
